spec.name: Furniture Console Table
spec.description: A slender walnut console with two inset drawers, small brass pulls, and a stepped cream ceramic vase. Four slim legs and recessed joinery give it a grounded survival-furniture silhouette. Front faces negative Z; all geometry is axis-aligned.

elements.name: Ceramic vase neck and recessed well

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: slender walnut entryway console table with two small drawers, brass handles and a cream ceramic vase. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
